about: Raw acquire/release calls that stay (tests/test_raii.py, docs/RAII.md section 3). Every entry needs a reason; the count is the number of raw calls the exemption covers. The lint fails on a new raw call and on an entry whose calls are gone: this list only shrinks.

allow.reason: the definition of memStackRelease itself (MemMark in include/engine/guard.hpp calls it)

scene slots: the per-level mark is taken in enter() and released in leave(), two calls of the scene stack machine (aulMark[level]), so no scope holds it; flowInit's game mark is the permanent bottom of the stack
ACE state callbacks: splashCreate hands the system back (systemUnuse), splashDestroy takes it again (systemUse); the pair spans two callbacks of the state manager
AllocDosObject; its FreeDosObject is the ms::scopeExit on the next line
adfShutdown closes the image handles that tryImage released into s_aImg[] (the images stay open for the whole run)
opFileOpen is the asm-side op of the scripted combat loader (src/game/combat_load.cpp, whose guard OpenFile pairs it with fileClose); open and close are two separate ops of the Ops table
rt_crash_c, the exception reporter: never returns (loops in Delay), so the log handle is deliberately never released
rt_crash_c, the exception reporter: never returns, the OS is never handed back
the 7-plane cel temp buffer s_pTemp lives from enhancedEnable to enhancedDisable (displayAceActivate / displayAceRelease), a static resource owned by the display lifetime
AllocDosObject in rt_file_list; its FreeDosObject is the ms::scopeExit on the next line

the file layer owns the handles that outlive a call: s_logFh (files.log, whole run), s_fh (the single file slot; tryOpen hands the stub / real file over, closeCurrent closes it), plus the stub bookkeeping of tryOpen
the definitions of the C ABI rt_file_open / rt_file_open_exact that rt::FileHandle wraps
the declarations of the C ABI rt_file_open / rt_file_open_exact that rt::FileHandle wraps

the overlay DATA snapshots (OverlayDef::pBackup): taken at the first entry of an overlay (imageEnter), freed after the overlay loop of rtGameRun; the overlay switches leave non-locally, so no scope spans them
MS_IRQ_TRACE debug build only: s_bpLog stays open for the whole run (the trace flush runs inside an OsAccess guard)
